description: This file defines the WeatherRepository class, which acts as an interface between the app and external data sources for weather information. It provides methods to fetch current weather, forecast data, manage favorite locations, and handle user preferences related to weather settings.

classes.name: WeatherRepository
classes.description: Repository class for interacting with weather APIs, managing local storage of favorite locations, and user weather preferences.

methods.name: getCurrentWeather
methods.description: Fetches current weather data for the given location query asynchronously.

methods.name: getForecast
methods.description: Fetches weather forecast data for the given location and number of days asynchronously.

methods.name: searchLocations
methods.description: Searches for locations matching the query asynchronously.

methods.name: addToFavorites
methods.description: Adds a location to the list of favorite locations.

methods.name: removeFromFavorites
methods.description: Removes a location from the list of favorite locations.

methods.name: getFavoriteLocations
methods.description: Retrieves the list of favorite locations stored locally.

methods.name: isInFavorites
methods.description: Checks whether a given location is in the list of favorites.

methods.name: saveWeatherSettings
methods.description: Saves the provided weather user settings.
